scope: Daringbadi live delivery and evidence-only receipt candidate before final review fields/view regeneration and commit

independent_release_checks.method: Direct read-only GitHub PR/run API and logs; successful build/deployment jobs observed.

independent_live_checks.normalization: Only /images/responsive/<16 lowercase hex digits>-<width>.webp filenames; every live responsive image in the article was fetched and its SHA-256 prefix checked.
independent_live_checks.variant_scope: Three Daringbadi hero variants plus three existing Deomali Continue Reading variants. All SHA prefixes verified; Daringbadi descriptors match actual widths and 4:3 dimensions.
independent_live_checks.method: Fresh HTTPS requests, in-memory image decoding/hash verification and HTML parsing. Web-reader access failed; direct HTTPS succeeded.

screenshot_review.observed: Readable desktop/mobile title, byline and dawn photograph; distinct coffee photograph with dated credit; actual mobile source-note list with return links; correct Daringbadi preview beside Deomali. No visible clipping in reviewed views.
screenshot_review.independent_action: Drishti visually inspected all five saved screenshots.
screenshot_review.interaction_attribution: Keyboard reference/return, reciprocal navigation and overflow measurements remain Disha browser observations; not independently repeated by Drishti.
screenshot_review.historical_limit_preserved: Earlier local mobile-footnotes capture showed prose; fresh live-footnotes now actually shows the source-note list. No retrospective claim that the earlier screenshot showed notes.

receipt_review.brass_fish_public_exclusion: Previously independently passed coastal/publication scans; publication source remains unchanged. No new dedicated draft integration.
receipt_review.scope_release_condition: Effective only after independently reviewed receipt merges. Putsil remains queued.
receipt_review.reason: Receipt modifies internal records and captured evidence only; delivered website source remains reviewed publication merge.

remaining_gate: Coordinator may add this accurately attributed review and one actual review event, regenerate views, commit the evidence-only receipt, pass required exact-head checks and merge it before beginning the next article.
limits: Separate AI review, not human specialist approval or field verification.
Viewport screenshots are not physical-device, screen-reader or cross-engine certification.
Receipt commit and its CI/merge do not yet exist at this review point.
Original image hash exclusion is not a perceptual search for every possible transformed brass-fish photograph.
